{{Top|leg}}
A '''light-minute''' was a unit of measurement used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was used to measure distances between [[Star/Legends|stars]] and [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The perihelions of orbits within the [[Goroth system/Legends|Goroth system]] were measured in light-minutes from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Goroth Alpha]]; [[Oris]]' perihelion was 2.6 light-minutes, [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime's]] was 7.1 light-minutes, [[Denava]] was 40.7 light-minutes, [[Denbalen]] was 67.2 light-minutes, and [[Goroth Beta]] was 340.3 light-minutes.<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref> [[Electrotelescope/Legends|Electrotelescopes]] were capable of detecting small [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] at a range of five light-minutes.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
